about: The embassies whose visa notices are read in the owner's Chrome (ingest_embassy_notices.py), the 20 consulates that issued the most employment-based immigrant visas from March 2025 to February 2026 in State's monthly files (Manila 7,523 down to Lagos 433). Each feed is WordPress's own feed of the site's Visas category. posts: the consulate pages' keys, the issuance tables' group_key of the post's name. tz: the embassy's own time zone, for the day a notice was posted.
